description: Machine-readable companion to VISUAL_ASSET_GUIDE.md. Each asset maps a UI slot to its file path, spec, brand treatment, and a ready-to-use generation prompt. Intended to drive a batch fetch/generate/place pipeline.

conventions.treatmentNote: Heroes use shared CSS utilities: the gets `hero-photo` (opacity 0.9) and the overlay gets `hero-scrim` (bg-gradient-to-t from-navy/85 via-navy/40 to-navy/55 - darkest at bottom, lightest in middle). The photo is MEANT to show through. Deliver full-colour images with a clear focal subject and a calmer band where the headline sits; do not pre-darken or add text. Edit .hero-photo/.hero-scrim in index.css to re-grade all heroes at once. (Per-asset imageOpacity values below are legacy hints; the live value is 0.9 via hero-photo, except the Landing mission band at ~0.6.)
antiPatterns: pale/low-contrast images that vanish under the navy wash

promptTemplate: Editorial documentary photograph, contemporary {subject}, golden-hour warm cinematic light, high contrast, premium magazine quality, dignified and aspirational, real people / modern architecture, shallow depth of field, dark enough to sit under a deep-navy gradient at 35% opacity, calm negative space {textZone} for a headline. No text, no logos, no flags, no poverty/charity cliches, no generic safari.
